mile.name: Grassville Program
mile.hl: Duel Gaming Chair and 'Professional Spectator' Desk
mile.hlText: Claimable when Grassville Program reaches Lv. 15 and 40

furni_enemyduel_chair_01: Chair for watching exciting competitions. A headrest and comfort pillow make it comfortable to sit in for long periods. Get the fatigue out of your system and get ready for the next round!
furni_enemyduel_table_01: A desk built to watch exciting competitions, complete with professional equipment. 'This side is definitely going to win. Trust me, I'm a pro.'

tips: In duel tourneys, send gifts to the side you think will win.
Keep a winning streak and stack as many gifts as you can.
The more you invest, the more you'll win—of course, you have to guess right first!
Remember to pick a team and send your gifts before the countdown runs out!
Other players' icons will be shown on the sides when selecting a team. Will you follow the trend, or trust in yourself?
Final decisions of other players will be hidden before the round begins, but you can still change your mind then.
If you haven't made up your mind before the round starts, the game will do it for you!
Remember to claim your rewards in time!
Guess along with your fellow spectators and join the rankings to win extra rewards.
